commands.stdout_excerpt:
commit 9e457ff86b7a17882354ba82885625522d66fcc0
Author: kernel-v1 task-1 worker <task-1-worker@kernel-v1.local>
Date:   Tue Jul 21 01:21:23 2026 -0400

    feat(preflight): add machine-readable BPF compatibility report
    
    Add a read-only host compatibility preflight (scripts/preflight.sh) and the
    v1 schema (schemas/preflight-v1.schema.json) for the kernel-v1 eBPF runtime
    security and observability platform.
    
    The preflight captures kernel identity, BTF readability and digest, active
    LSM list, cgroup mode, bpffs/tracefs/debugfs mount points, capability
    state, BPF helper symbol presence, container runtime, and per-sensor
    capable|degraded|blocked status. The script is strictly non-mutating: it
    never invokes sudo, never writes sysctls, never loads kernel modules, never
    mounts/unmounts filesystems, never starts a service, and never attaches a
    lasting BPF probe. Exit codes are 0 capable, 2 degraded, 77 blocked.
    
    Mocking for fixtures is gated on BOTH BPF_TEST_MODE env var AND the
    explicit --test-mode CLI flag, with a loud stderr banner so it is never
    silent.
    
    Also adds crates/preflight-schema, a typed parser + validator that loads
    the embedded schema, runs it through jsonschema, and performs the
    semantic cross-checks defined by task 3 (status<->sensor aggregation,
    can_load<->no-cap- reasons, btf.readable<->status consistency). The
    validate-preflight binary loads a JSON file and exits 0/1 with the
    offending JSON pointer on stderr.
    
    Closes task 3 of .omo/plans/ebpf-runtime-security-observability.md.
